fusions.name: Tongue's Length
fusions.desc: Snaps out at a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Dredged Muck
fusions.desc: Flings a cone of pond muck 3 tiles ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance per hit to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mud Coat
fusions.desc: Rakes a coat of mud over you: a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and your armour rises by 5%. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Coiled to Spring
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
